main_measure.name: day-clustered slope of 5-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: slope > 0 with t >= 2 confirms (with tercile difference > 0); t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: top-minus-bottom forecast tercile mean excess 5-bar return

decided_by: the slope is positive with t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom tercile difference is above 0
reading: Cases are the non-overlapping 5-bar grid bars (positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window) with near_high recorded, excess return = 5-bar return minus the coin's mean 5-bar grid return over all its windows; 'cases of one day summed together' is read as an OLS slope with standard errors clustered by day; terciles are three equal-count groups of the pooled cases ranked by forecast (ties by order).

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
